opening.argument: The presenter opens by promising to explain startup funding, then walks through financing rounds, investor shares, valuations, and dilution. A graphic showing groups of shares supports that explanation. The boot camp and free financial-model download are presented as resources for founders learning these subjects, not as a specific investment opportunity. Nothing in the available video evidence describes deceptive claims, requires viewers to pay, or solicits a transfer of money or data. The observable content is an educational account of how startup financing works.

citations.quote: I'm going to explain everything I know about start-up funding in this video
Pre-seed rounds are meant to build and launch products Seed rounds are raised when the product is launched or when it's growing
Same number of shares that represent a different percentage of the business. If these valuation numbers seemed arbitrary, they are.
A free download too, linked in the description. I've also put together a boot camp to help founders master this stuff, the financial modelling, forecasting, formulas.
